_readme: Merge the 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-level, so every
project reports to the deck) or .claude/settings.json for one project.
Replace HOOK_PATH with the absolute path to opendeck-hook.sh, e.g.
Every hook is fire-and-forget with a 1s timeout and always exits 0, so a
stopped daemon can never block or fail an agent turn.
Notification is what powers the approve screen. It only fires when the
harness actually asks for permission - a session launched with
--dangerously-skip-permissions never asks, so approvals stay dormant there.
